description: This is a Java interface named EncounterService defining the contract for managing Encounter entities within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, updating, voiding, purging, and searching encounters, as well as managing related entities like encounter types and roles, and performing permission checks.

classes.name: EncounterService
classes.description: This interface defines the contract for services related to Encounter management within OpenMRS, including CRUD operations, search functionalities, permission checks, and related entity management.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Saves a new encounter or updates an existing encounter, cascading changes to related observations, orders, providers, and encounter visit assignment if applicable.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatient
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided encounters for a specific patient, sorted by encounter date.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided encounters for a patient by their ID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches all encounters for a patient identified by their identifier.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters based on various nullable criteria, such as location, date range, form, type, provider, visit, and visit type.

methods.name: getEncounters(EncounterSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves encounters based on a search criteria object, supporting complex queries.

methods.name: voidEncounter
methods.description: Voids an encounter, cascading to observations and orders, effectively removing it from circulation.

methods.name: unvoidEncounter
methods.description: Reverses the void status of an encounter, cascading to observations and orders.

methods.name: purgeEncounter
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter from the database.

methods.name: purgeEncounter(Encounter, boolean)
methods.description: Deletes an encounter and optionally its related observations and orders.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Creates or updates an encounter type.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by its internal ID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter type by exact name.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all encounter types, excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes(boolean)
methods.description: Returns all encounter types, including retired if specified.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Finds encounter types with names matching a partial, case-insensitive string, including retired types.

methods.name: retireEncounterType
methods.description: Marks an encounter type as retired, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: unretireEncounterType
methods.description: Reverts a retired encounter type to active status.

methods.name: purgeEncounterType
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter type from the database.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters for a patient identified by name or identifier.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Searches encounters by patient name or identifier with inclusion of voided encounters.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters with batch control and filter options.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Searches encounters by various criteria including patient id, provider, location, type, form, within a batch.

methods.name: getAllEncounters
methods.description: Returns all encounters for a set of patients in a cohort.

methods.name: getCountOfEncounters
methods.description: Returns the total count of encounters matching a search query.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves encounters associated with a specific visit, with option to include voided.

methods.name: getEncounterVisitHandlers
methods.description: Returns the list of handlers for visit assignment logic for encounters.

methods.name: getActiveEncounterVisitHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active visit assignment handler.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Creates or updates an encounter role.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter role by its internal ID.

methods.name: purgeEncounterRole
methods.description: Permanently deletes an encounter role from the database.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all encounter roles, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an encounter role by UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Finds an encounter role by its name.

methods.name: retireEncounterRole
methods.description: Marks an encounter role as retired.

methods.name: unretireEncounterRole
methods.description: Reverts a retired encounter role to active status.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Fetches unvoided encounters for a patient that are not assigned to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters for a patient within visits, with filtering options.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts the number of encounters matching visit and patient criteria.

methods.name: filterEncountersByViewPermissions
methods.description: Filters a list of encounters to those viewable by a specific user.

methods.name: canViewAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view all encounter types.

methods.name: canEditAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to edit all encounter types.

methods.name: canEditEncounter
methods.description: Checks if a user can edit a specific encounter.

methods.name: canViewEncounter
methods.description: Checks if a user can view a specific encounter.

methods.name: checkIfEncounterTypesAreLocked
methods.description: Throws an exception if encounter types are locked and cannot be modified.

methods.name: getEncounterRolesByName
methods.description: Retrieves encounter roles matching a partial name.

methods.name: transferEncounter
methods.description: Transfers an encounter to another patient, voiding the original.
